question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Out of the woods
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "out of the woods"** means to be out of danger or difficulty, or to have moved past a threatening situation. 
 
• It is** often used to** describe a situation that was problematic or dangerous but is no longer so.
 
• **Out of danger:** This means that one is no longer in a position or situation where harm might occur.(खतरे से बाहर)

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: '**Out of danger'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's go through all the options with their meanings in English and Hindi:

 
 
• **To meet with disaster: **This phrase means to encounter a sudden or unexpected event causing great damage, loss, or hardship.(आपत्ति से मिलना)
 
• **Not adhering to rules: **This phrase means not following or obeying rules, laws, or regulations.(नियमों का पालन नहीं करना).
 
• **To lose contact: **This phrase means to stop communication or lose connection with someone or something.(संपर्क खो देना).
